channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Prosecutors Examined Firm With Tie to Judge in Trump Hush Money Trial
item.description: The U.S. attorney in Chicago subpoenaed a fund-raising firm that had been co-owned by the daughter of Judge Juan Merchan, who conducted the trial that led to Donald Trump’s felony conviction.

item.title: NPR: 5 exercises that can prevent (and relieve!) pregnancy pain
item.description: Hemorrhoids, leg cramps, sciatica — oh my! Alongside the joy of pregnancy often comes a parade of physical discomfort. Alleviate and prevent common aches with these exercises.

item.title: BBC News: Tributes paid to Jason Arday after ex-Cambridge professor found dead
item.description: His family said they were "in shock" to have lost him, adding a "campaign of misinformation" had been too much.

item.title: The Guardian: Christopher Berry-Dee is the UK’s all-time bestselling true crime author. Is he also a violent abuser of women and children?
item.description: The British writer is known for his unique ability to get inside the heads of serial killers. But a Guardian investigation reveals multiple accusations of assault and child sexual abuse. What is the truth about the man d…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Bangladesh rock Australia as historic Test win in sight
item.description: Australia close Day Three of the first Test against Bangladesh on 161-4, trailing the record-chasing tourists by 67.

item.title: Ars Technica: Vulnerability giving attackers full control of Macs is under active exploitation
item.description: Screen-sharing bug lets remote hackers log in without a password.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: 5 Weird Tricks for Having a Brain
item.description: From the multibrained octopus to the bitty brain organoid, we’re all just inference engines making flawed bets on the future. Here are the five insights your brain will need to survive.

item.title: WIRED Science: Puerto Rico Is Rationing Water. It Could’ve Avoided It by Harvesting Rainwater
item.description: The island could capture billions of gallons of water a year if it implemented systems to catch it as it falls from the sky.

item.title: WIRED Business: The Next Big Influencer Is This 4-Foot-Tall Robot From China
item.description: The Unitree G1 has found online fame as a relatively affordable robot that can charm a crowd. But can it ever hold down a real job?

item.title: The New Yorker: How Trump Is Trying to Weaken Migrant Children’s Legal Defense
item.description: After failing to eliminate funding for unaccompanied minors’ lawyers altogether, the Administration is pushing cases toward entities that lack both immigration expertise and the capacity to take them on.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: The Woman Telling Her Husband About Her Hookup
item.description: In this week’s story, a newly open marriage experiences growing pains.

item.description: On a scale from the Top of the Rock to the top floor of Pebble Bar, where does the former Succession star fit?
